neighbours.label: The name of a field or area that opens a coordinated pair ('for health and safety', 'of science, technology ...', 'in language, cross-cultural ...'), on the field noun itself; ordinary nouns in the same frames stay low.
fire: All staff must wear gloves in the lab for health and safety reasons.
She is a Senior Fellow for Energy Policy at the university.
The journal covers the future of science, medicine and society.
Volunteers get lessons in language, local customs and first aid.
He holds a chair in Climate Economics at the new school.
Applicants will be trained in policy, budgeting and law.
A conference on the future of design, art and technology opens today.

The journal arrived at the end of the week in a brown envelope.
Volunteers get lunch in a tent beside the old river bridge.

Applicants will be seated in rows of ten at the hall.
